summary.text: Emily Study is the Republican candidate for Wyoming House of Representatives District 14 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Trey Sherwood.
A Veterans Service Coordinator and Veterans Service Officer, she describes herself in a Ballotpedia survey as a naturalized U.S. citizen and a military spouse.

paragraphs.text: Emily Study graduated from Campbell County High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Wyoming in 2005 and an associate degree from Laramie County Community College in 2016.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she came to Wyoming as a child, was the first in her family to attend college, and raised her family in the state with her husband, who served more than two decades in the military.
She said she has worked for more than 26 years with military members, veterans, caregivers and families.
Study advanced from the August 18, 2026 Republican primary for District 14.
In the survey, she listed service and accountability, local control, limited government and property rights, and vocational and workforce opportunities for young people as her key messages.
